# devhop
> Zero-config mobile dev proxy for testing local web apps on physical phones with working HMR and microphone/camera permissions.

- CLI: `npx devhop [port]`
- Repo: https://github.com/fullstacked-labs/devhop
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/devhop
- Docs: https://github.com/fullstacked-labs/devhop#readme

## Key Capabilities
- Solves Next.js 14-16 `allowedDevOrigins` cross-origin HMR WebSocket blocking.
- Solves iOS Safari / Android Chrome HTTP Secure Context blocks (`getUserMedia`, camera, crypto).
- Masquerades Host, Origin, and Referer headers in-process to `localhost:<port>`.
- Generates ASCII terminal QR code for instant phone camera scanning.
- Zero signup, zero accounts, zero system daemons.
